name: Data Science subset of Applied Data Science
spec_quote: Two answers match when, after lower-casing and dropping punctuation, one is a contiguous run of whole words of the other and the shorter has at least two words ("Data Science" matches "Applied Data Science"; "Science" does not match "Data Science"; "Economics" does not match "Applied Economics" because the shorter has only one word).

name: Science one word does not match Data Science
spec_quote: "Science" does not match "Data Science"

name: Economics one word does not match Applied Economics
spec_quote: "Economics" does not match "Applied Economics" because the shorter has only one word

name: None-like part ignored on longer side
spec_quote: Parts that are "none", "n/a" or "no minor" (a none-like part) on the side that has MORE parts are ignored when the other side has no none-like part, so "Applied Data Science | None" matches "Data Science".
